assumptions.text: A1. The contemplated product is the prototype Presta-pattern valve core of [0027] and [0092], offered alone, as a valve with its stem, and fitted to an inner tube or tubeless set-up ([0095], [0123]).

A2. Common general knowledge (patent practice): making, using, selling, offering or importing are infringing acts in the jurisdiction where they occur, so the country of manufacture is a jurisdiction of interest alongside US, EP and UK.
A3. Live status, expiry and claim scope of US11179979B2, US11338632B2 and US6053992A are not verified; only index dates and saved claim text are used.

open_questions.text: Q1. Where will the seat rings and valve cores be made, and by whom?
Q2. Will the product be sold only as a replacement valve core, or also as a complete valve with stem, or fitted to tubes with sealant?
Q3. For counsel: should a professional FTO search be commissioned before launch in US, EP and UK, covering at least items 1 and 3 with classification searching in F16K15/20, F16K15/14 and B60C29/00?
